source_evidence.content:
Author Workshop session source for Scene 1 workflow bundle.

User seed: ancient aliens and pre-tech civilization

Approved-in-chat working direction: a short three-scene speculative story about a pre-technological ritual-astronomical civilization living among ancient alien ruins misunderstood as sacred architecture; the protagonist is an apprentice sky-reader; the first scene should focus on the opening sky-count ritual and generate Scene 1 prose through the StoryWriter scene-prose workflow.

Author request: work on Scene 1 workflow to generate prose, then commit the current workflow artifacts to the dataset.
